reasons.plausibility: Introducing 10-20 vol% pores into a metallic alloy will inevitably and drastically reduce strength and ductility due to stress concentration and reduced load-bearing area, contradicting well-established knowledge of porous metals.
reasons.testability: The proposed test (tensile testing and density measurement) is clear and directly addresses the hypothesis, with a specific, quantitative falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (pores maintaining strength) that is fundamentally unsound, making it a dead-end for a researcher seeking a viable solution.
